cd /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-muahmed-Desktop-Projects-RL-for-Real-World-Environments/54b8300a-e533-4d3f-9f31-c0f8369fa981/scratchpad/lhrun2/runs/r2_main/samples/abb11dc619f775b5/a1/work/ws && python -c "
import parse

# Test __contains__ with various scenarios
print('=== Testing __contains__ comprehensively ===')

# Named field only
p1 = parse.compile('{name}')
r1 = p1.parse('hello')
print(f'Named field result: {r1}')
print(f'  \"hello\" in r1: {\"hello\" in r1}')
print(f'  \"name\" in r1: {\"name\" in r1}')
print(f'  1 in r1: {1 in r1}')

# Fixed field only (anonymous)
p2 = parse.compile('{}')
r2 = p2.parse('world')
print(f'Anonymous field result: {r2}')
print(f'  \"world\" in r2: {\"world\" in r2}')
print(f'  0 in r2: {0 in r2}')

# Mixed
p3 = parse.compile('{name} {}')
r3 = p3.parse('Alice Bob')
print(f'Mixed result: {r3}')
print(f'  \"Alice\" in r3: {\"Alice\" in r3}')
print(f'  \"Bob\" in r3: {\"Bob\" in r3}')
print(f'  \"name\" in r3: {\"name\" in r3}')
print(f'  0 in r3: {0 in r3}')
print(f'  1 in r3: {1 in r3}')

# Numeric values
p4 = parse.compile('{age:d}')
r4 = p4.parse('42')
print(f'Numeric result: {r4}')
print(f'  42 in r4: {42 in r4}')
print(f'  \"42\" in r4: {\"42\" in r4}')  # Should be False since converted to int
